verdict.rationale: Probe evidence implies irs.gov publishes a content robots.txt: irs-probe-5 notes /dmaf is not disallowed by it. But the EIN online assistant runs on an application host whose robots.txt returned HTTP 503, and the main robots.txt does not govern that host (irs-probe-4). The robots.txt also misleads an agent: /dmaf is allowed, yet the online Form 15620 entry returned 403 to an agent with no credentials. missing for 10: a stable robots.txt on the application hosts (sa.www4.irs.gov), robots rules that match actual access controls, and direct evidence of the irs.gov robots.txt contents.
